parameters.name: FromTimeService
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to immediately run the task or run it during a scheduled time window. Valid values:

- false (default): The task is run during a scheduled time window.
- true: The task is immediately run.

parameters.name: PlannedEndTime
parameters.description: The latest time to start running the scheduled task. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: PlannedStartTime
parameters.description: The earliest time to start running the scheduled task (that is, the task is run within the specified time range). Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC).
